#  independent references

The numeric gates exercise the physical invariant I(textured)/I(random) =
the orbit average of f + (1-f) [r² cos²(alpha) + sin²(alpha)/r]^(-3/2).
The baseline is a normalization operand, never a golden intensity.
Source: FullProf manual, preferred orientation NOR=1:
https://www.psi.ch/sites/default/files/import/lns-diffraction/LinuxEN/fullprof-manual.pdf
Angles use the reciprocal metric. The cubic (100), (110), (111) orbits and
orthorhombic axis reflections are enumerated analytically in the gate.

Public spelling follows diffraction-lib's committed preferred_orientation category:
structure_id, march_r, march_random_fract, index_h, index_k, index_l.
Nonidentity ratios on both sides of one prevent reciprocal-convention escapes.
The model fixture is an authored synthetic Gd powder, inherited from ;
it is not a FullProf project. The page digests are upstream bytes, never generated output.
